brief: @buildthis.bisks.net space ghost coast to coast simulator. You play as a guest on the talk show space ghost coast to coast and the crew interviews you or whatever they do. Best website of the year 1998.
note: you're the guest tonight. answer Space Ghost's questions, survive Zorak's heckling and Moltar's technical difficulties, walk away with an episode title, a ghostly rating, and a card to share.
